title: Places in my mallworld
content: Been having mall world dreams for several years.Here are some places in my mall world. The mall - a one story mall with wooden floor and some wood paneling on the walls. I go to the left and there is a theatre. I dont go in but there are movie posters on the wall. Before the theater there is a door. I go in it is a locker/ changing room with bathrooms. The water park - a wooden roller coaster that becomes a water ride. The college - huge concrete building with large windows that ends in a huge food court. Sometimes this ends in a medical building with people in hospital rooms, etc. College town - a college town street that is transformed into a boardwalk type atmosphere The other side of town - getting home from the other side of town on a bike riding the streets are all a boardwalk type atmosphere again with shops outside. The bridge- to cross the bridge you have to ride a roller coaster type thing the water is dirty you hope is doesnt splash on you.
